record_type_quote: The purpose of this study was to replicate and expand on Persky, Nelson, Watson, and Bent (2008) study of characteristics related to nurses who were effective in Watson's Caritas framework.

targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to replicate and expand on Persky, Nelson, Watson, and Bent (2008) study of characteristics related to nurses who were effective in Watson's Caritas framework.
targets.outcome_quote: Six of the 13 HES scales were positively associated with CFS scores. As nurses' positive perceptions of the work environment increased, patients' perceptions of caring increased. Our findings contrast Persky et al.'s.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract identifies poorer environments as associated with greater caring in the original, reports the opposite relationship, and explicitly contrasts its findings with Persky et al.
